title: No Entry Desert Vision
description: A surreal desert landscape at twilight features a massive glowing red celestial body with starry patterns in a swirling purple and yellow sky. In the foreground, a stylized dual-faced female figure with green labyrinthine hair holds a weathered 'NO ENTRY' sign, while glowing green pathways wind across the sandy terrain dotted with saguaro cacti.
prompt: Surreal desert scene at dusk with a giant glowing red orb filled with stars dominating a swirling purple and yellow sky. In the foreground, a stylized woman with one pink and one dark red profile face holds a rusty 'NO ENTRY' sign. Her hair is composed of intricate green labyrinth patterns that flow into glowing green winding pathways across the desert floor. Scattered saguaro cacti stand in the background under the cosmic sky, psychedelic visionary art style.
